cause: after the question was approved and its first ideas filed

4-learning-curve-of-a-clip-logistic-regr.line: The free offline test that says whether CLIP embeddings separate tags at all; every other idea leans on it.

why.impact: A clear win or loss here decides most of the question without anyone judging a picture.
why.odds: Linear probes worked in pixltagger, but on a stronger backbone with thousands of labels, not CLIP ViT-B/32 with 100.
why.path: Ideas 5 to 9 all need its harness and its answer first.

6-add-random-unjudged-pictures-as-backgr.line: A cheap offline fix for the review-picked negatives, worth settling before a person judges anything.

why.impact: It changes which classifier goes in front of the person in idea 5.
why.odds: Review rejects are near-misses, so background negatives plausibly help the top of the ranking, but it may change little.
why.path: Waits for idea 4's harness; idea 5 should use whichever variant wins.

7-combine-the-classifier-and-the-near-ne.line: Offline and cheap, and it decides whether idea 5 should judge a combined list.

why.impact: If the two rankers find different positives, the shipped source should be the combination.
why.odds: Two rankers in pixltagger barely overlapped, which suggests a gain, but that was a different task.
why.path: Waits for idea 4; feeds the choice of what idea 5 tests.

5-a-person-judges-the-classifier-s-top-1.line: The go/no-go test #2678 names, but it costs a person's time, so it runs once the offline ideas pick the variant.

why.impact: Confirms on unjudged pictures are the issue's own success measure.
why.odds: Depends on idea 4; held-out verdicts can flatter a ranker that only finds twins.
why.path: Waits for idea 4, and should use the winners of ideas 6 and 7.

9-a-stronger-picture-embedding-for-tags-.line: Only worth running if idea 4 fails on detail tags but works on broad ones.

why.impact: A larger embedding costs storage and a library pass, so a win is useful but expensive to ship.
why.odds: DINOv3 probes did well in pixltagger, so the odds are fair if CLIP is the bottleneck.
why.path: Waits for idea 4 to show which tags CLIP cannot separate.

8-pick-the-next-pictures-to-judge-by-the.line: Last: a similar out-of-fold ranking did no better than random in pixltagger, and it only speeds up a classifier that must work first.

why.impact: It saves verdicts but does not answer whether the classifier works.
why.odds: Idea 2 found out-of-fold surfacing at 11% against 10% random. Not yet judged.
